title: Portugal secures independence at Aljubarrota
summary: A Portuguese army under King John I and Nuno Alvares Pereira, aided by English archers, crushed a much larger Castilian invasion force.
reason: After the death of King Ferdinand I, John I of Castile claimed the Portuguese crown through his wife, and Portuguese supporters of the House of Aviz resisted.
significance: It secured Portuguese independence and the Aviz dynasty that later launched the age of exploration.
